question: Did the risk of a motorist being killed per mile driven in NYC decline from 2013 to 2025? Make a chart and answer based on this crash data.

options.reason: Annual deaths directly show whether the fatality burden rose or fell, without implying an exposure-adjusted risk.
options.answer: This crash file cannot determine per-mile risk; recorded annual motorist deaths fell from 110 in 2013 to 81 in 2025 (26.4%).

options.answer: This crash file cannot determine per-mile risk; motorist deaths per 100,000 reported crashes rose from 54.0 in 2013 to 94.7 in 2025 (75.4%).
